summary: Sends TOP image data out over RenderStream. Connection setup and sync are handled by RenderStream In CHOP.

key_params.name: profilechop
key_params.note: Optional profiling channels sent to the D3/Disguise UI.

common_gotchas: This TOP sends data but does not own session setup or sync; use RenderStream In CHOP for control.
Stream Index must match the intended RenderStream stream.
Profile CHOP is profiling metadata for the D3/Disguise UI, not an image input.
key_concepts: Sends TOP image data out over Disguise RenderStream.
RenderStream In CHOP still owns setup and synchronization for the session.
Stream Index targets the intended RenderStream output stream.
Profile CHOP sends profiling metadata channels to the D3/Disguise UI rather than image data.
